## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request only changes my add-on folder, `addons/<id>/`.
- [ ] *Test my add-on...* in XAML.io says *No problems found in its files*.
- [ ] I dropped every item on a page: each one renders, and the app builds and runs with *Start*.
- [ ] The NuGet package is on nuget.org, and the version that `addon.xml` installs works in XAML.io.
- [ ] `Publisher`, `License` and `Website` are filled in, and I may publish the texts, icons and screenshots.
- [ ] Images are PNG, JPEG or WebP, each under 500 KB.
- [ ] For a commercial library: `<Pricing>` gives the price and the trial, and the items render during the trial.
